enemyDebuffs.name: Stunned
enemyDebuffs.description: Enemy is stunned and can not perform any actions. Stun duration depends on stun source and enemy stun resistance. Elite and Boss enemies can not be stunned.
enemyDebuffs.sources: Melee Attack; Blessing: Static Concussion; Blessing: Anchors
enemyDebuffs.unmodeled: no numeric damage effect the DSL can express

enemyDebuffs.name: Frozen
enemyDebuffs.description: Enemy is frozen and can not perform any actions; frozen flying enemies fall down to the ground. Elite and Boss enemies still count as Frozen, but their actions are not impaired. Enemies with only partial freeze buildup still count as frozen.
enemyDebuffs.unmodeled: no numeric damage effect the DSL can express
